source: I want clicker game and I want a chill park map that I can walk around In with my roblox character. I want there to be a rebirth buttons that doubles clicks. An admin panel only i have and i can give any amount of clicks up to infinity and can start a 2x event and can talk to every globally in game. I want there to be an egg with pets a uncommon pig pet with a 60% chance to get, a rare cat with a 25% chance to get, an epic dog with a 10% chance to get, a legendary horse with a 1% chance, a mythic shark with a 0.1% chance, and a secret turtle with a 0.01% chance to get. I want no labels or texts on my screen or on the ground too

answers.ask: Should the park read as bright and cartoony, or a naturalistic modern city park?
answers.answer: Make it a bright, cartoony chill park that fits a Roblox clicker game.

answers.ask: Is the rebirth button a physical thing you walk up to in the park, or a screen button?
answers.answer: Make the rebirth button a physical button players walk up to in the park, with no text labels.

blob:
## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: Should the park read as bright and cartoony, or a naturalistic modern city park? A: Make it a bright, cartoony chill park that fits a Roblox clicker game.
- [author] shape — Q: Is the rebirth button a physical thing you walk up to in the park, or a screen button? A: Make the rebirth button a physical button players walk up to in the park, with no text labels.
- [agent_inferred] scale — Q: How large should the unspecified walkable park be? A: Use one small, compact park so the egg and rebirth button remain easy to reach on foot.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a small, bright, cartoony chill park that avatars can freely walk around. Use simple looping paths through open lawn and trees, linking two distinct unlabeled interaction spots: one physical rebirth button set into a small ground platform and one large pet egg on a simple pedestal. Keep both features visually identifiable through shape and color alone. Do not place labels, signs, written text, stat gates, training stations, or tiered progression zones anywhere in the park.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation because clicking, pet hatching, and rebirth progression define the game.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-open`: one shared persistent park is freely walkable, with no personal plots or separate progression maps. Preset: none; Incremental Simulator would add a shop hub and physical progression gates the author did not request.

## Config requirements
Use `path-circulation` for simple looping park paths connecting the rebirth platform and pet egg. Draw one unlabeled physical rebirth button and one large egg pedestal as scene-specific geometry. No text-bearing structures or physical click-training stations should appear.

## Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-rebirth` trigger exactly on the unlabeled physical button platform. Place one scene-specific TriggerZone egg-hatching interaction with no canonical option ID at the egg pedestal. The six pet types and their probabilities are economy data rather than map placements, and the admin panel, events, and global chat add no geometry.

## Layout components
The build is one small park zone with open lawn, simple trees, a looping path network, one rebirth-button platform, and one pet-egg pedestal. The park boundary is compact and visually enclosed by planting rather than signs. Compose both interaction spots and their path connection clearly in one frame, with no visible writing.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the relaxed park composition and readable unlabeled props lead, and no exact topology needs procedural construction.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is small, inferred so the two interaction points remain a short walk apart. The theme is bright, cartoony, and relaxed. Use `P0`; the park is one continuous, single-level walkable surface.
